import struct, json

data = open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()

def read_varint(buf, off):
    v = 0
    for i in range(9):
        b = buf[off+i]
        if i == 8:
            v = v * 256 + b
            return v, off+9
        v = v * 128 + (b % 128)
        if b < 128:
            return v, off+i+1
    return v, off+9

def decode_record(buf, off):
    hsize, off = read_varint(buf, off)
    types = []
    for _ in range(hsize-1):
        t, off = read_varint(buf, off)
        types.append(t)
    vals = []
    for t in types:
        if t == 0: vals.append(None)
        elif t == 1: vals.append(struct.unpack('b', buf[off:off+1])[0]); off+=1
        elif t == 2: vals.append(struct.unpack('>h', buf[off:off+2])[0]); off+=2
        elif t == 3: vals.append(int.from_bytes(buf[off:off+3],'big',signed=True)); off+=3
        elif t == 4: vals.append(struct.unpack('>i', buf[off:off+4])[0]); off+=4
        elif t == 5: vals.append(int.from_bytes(buf[off:off+6],'big',signed=True)); off+=6
        elif t == 6: vals.append(struct.unpack('>q', buf[off:off+8])[0]); off+=8
        elif t == 7: vals.append(struct.unpack('>d', buf[off:off+8])[0]); off+=8
        elif t == 8: vals.append(0)
        elif t == 9: vals.append(1)
        elif t >= 13:
            n = (t-13)//2
            if t % 2 == 1:
                vals.append(buf[off:off+n].decode('utf-8')); off+=n
            else:
                vals.append(buf[off:off+n]); off+=n
        else:
            raise ValueError('bad serial type %d' % t)
    return vals, off

ncells = int.from_bytes(data[3:5],'big')
ptrs = [int.from_bytes(data[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncells)]
rows = []
for p in ptrs:
    plen, o = read_varint(data, p)
    rowid, o = read_varint(data, o)
    vals, end = decode_record(data, o)
    rows.append((rowid, vals, plen, end - o))
    print('ptr=%d rowid=%d vals=%s payload=%d recordlen=%d %s' % (p, rowid, vals, plen, end-o, 'OK' if plen==end-o else 'MISMATCH'))

rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
out = []
for rowid, vals, plen, rlen in rows:
    word = None; value = None
    for v in vals:
        if isinstance(v, str): word = v
        elif isinstance(v, (int, float)):
            if value is None: value = v
    out.append({"word": word, "value": value})

with open('/app/recover.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
print(json.dumps(out))

assert len(page2) == 4096

cols = [('table',1), ('t',1), ('CREATE TABLE t(a, word TEXT, value)',35), ('int',4)]
types = []
for name, t in cols:
    if t == 4: types.append(4)
    else: types.append(13 + 2*t)
hsize = 1 + len(types)
payload = hsize
payload += 1 + 1 + 35 + 4  # text bytes + int32
cell = bytes([payload, 1])  # payload len varint, rowid=1
cell += bytes([hsize]) + bytes(types)
cell += b'table' + b't' + b'CREATE TABLE t(a, word TEXT, value)'
cell += struct.pack('>i', 2)
assert len(cell) == payload + 2, (len(cell), payload)
content_start = 4096 - len(cell)

# Page 1: 100-byte DB header + b-tree leaf header + cell pointer + cell
hdr = bytearray(100)
hdr[0:16] = b'SQLite format 3\x00'
struct.pack_into('>H', hdr, 16, 4096)      # page size
hdr[18] = 1                                 # write version
hdr[19] = 1                                 # read version
hdr[20] = 0                                 # reserved
hdr[21] = 64; hdr[22] = 32; hdr[23] = 32    # payload fractions
struct.pack_into('>I', hdr, 24, 1)          # change counter
struct.pack_into('>I', hdr, 28, 2)          # db size in pages
struct.pack_into('>I', hdr, 40, 1)          # schema cookie
struct.pack_into('>I', hdr, 44, 4)          # schema format
struct.pack_into('>I', hdr, 56, 1)          # utf-8
struct.pack_into('>I', hdr, 92, 1)          # version-valid-for
struct.pack_into('>I', hdr, 96, 3040000)    # sqlite version number

page1 += bytes([0x0d, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01, (content_start >> 8) % 256, content_start % 256, 0x00])
page1 += struct.pack('>H', 108 + 8)  # cell pointer at offset 116
page1 += cell
